$comment: Feature ledger. `since` = hand-curated landing SHAs per long-lived lineage (main/dev/prod); `verify` = unit tests whose pass is the authoritative presence check on a checkout. docs/FEATURES.md is generated from this file by scripts/generate-features-matrix.mjs.

features.title: Per-connection allowedModels allowlist
features.description: Provider connections can restrict which models they serve; requests for models outside the allowlist skip that connection.

features.title: Antigravity App/Hub identity + Argon tiers
features.description: Antigravity requests present the App (Hub) client identity instead of the retired IDE profile; adds the Gemini 4 Argon tiers.

features.title: OpenCode free-tier fingerprint + Bearer public
features.description: OpenCode free-tier requests carry the native opencode v2 header/request deltas and the anonymous public Bearer.

features.title: Call-log in-memory dedupe correlation fallback
features.description: The call-logs API de-duplicates in-memory and persisted entries for the same request, falling back to correlation matching when ids differ.
